annotations.text:
Storage first, then resume, then create.
Creating a session on landing would orphan one already in progress — so the app looks in localStorage, calls GET /sessions/:id, and only then POSTs a new one.

The graded demo.
Answering Yes reveals both questions in place and announces them; answering No removes them and the page converges. Pruning is watched, not hidden two screens back — which is the whole case for one page over a wizard.

Server-rejected submit.
A summary that is reachable, not just visible, focus moved to the first invalid item, and messages built from codes — the body never echoes an answer.

Respondent scale: 52px option rows, 44px inputs, 16px type — deliberately larger than the shared 32px primitives, which stay as they are in admin.
No painted status bar: the real one draws on top.

Decisions Log #53 drawn: one sort axis, most recently edited, client-side. No search, no status filter, no sortable columns this wave — that surface is gh#21.
Drawing it found a gap: QuestionnaireSummary carries createdAt and no updatedAt, so there is nothing on the wire to sort on yet.

Decisions Log #54 drawn: a summary rail fed by POST /draft/validate — the identical code publish runs, so the editor cannot show green where publish says no. Findings are reached by item number and the rows stay unmarked; inline per-item marking is gh#22.

Open question 4 in the frontend doc — how visible the 409 path is.
Proposed: reorder is optimistic and snaps back with a toast; the banner is the only thing that stops the author, and it offers exactly one action.

§20's options-authoring widget, proposed: drag to reorder, ids shown and locked, freeform marked on the row.
Editing a question from inside the draft re-pins that item to the new version. Every other questionnaire keeps the version it pinned, which is what makes the v2 relabel safe.
Settled in the frontend doc §3 and drawn here so Track 7 builds from a picture: five types, one control each, plus the Yes/No template and the freeform Other behaviour.

The one Stop-and-ask item still open (§20 Pending UI experimentation): the constraint fields per type and how the dialog switches them. Proposed here, with the six cross-field rules made unrepresentable rather than reported.

Decisions Log #55 drawn: one errorsByItemId in packages/ui for both apps, dropping the two codes that never attach to an item.
One gap found: the ten draft codes still have no message catalogue.
